feeds.title: BushcraftUK - Bushcraft & outdoor adventures
feeds.description: BushcraftUK is a great resource for everyone interested in the skills and knowledge needed to get more from the great outdoors, find Courses and Expeditions, get on the BushMoot and much more.

feeds.title: Wildway bushcraft Blog
feeds.description: This blog shares information on bushcraft, survival and wilderness living. We hope that you find it useful but remember, nothing replaces practical, hands-on experience. Keep up with tips, hints and reviews on everything bushcraft and survival.

feeds.title: Jack Raven Bushcraft Blog
feeds.description: Find bushcraft teachings, wilderness and survival skills from our ancient woodland camp on the North Downs in Kent. This blog is regularly updated with informative posts, articles on key skills & news about our courses and team building events in the south east on the Kent Downs.

feeds.title: Backcountry Survival Blog
feeds.description: Backcountry Survival offers unique Bushcraft and Survival Courses in Scotland and North East England tailored to all experience and ability levels. Keep up to date with our Wilderness And Survival Courses in Scotland with our blog. We feature news on all things bushcraft and survival in Scotland.

feeds.title: Buzzard Bushcraft
feeds.description: This Blog is written by the author of Buzzard Bushcraft. Blog focuses on Bushcraft, fishing, trapping, the outdoors and the ocean.

feeds.title: The Ray Mears & Woodlore Bushcraft Blog
feeds.description: In 1983, the British bushcraft and survival expert Ray Mears founded Woodlore, The School of Wilderness Bushcraft. Woodlore is the leader in its field and continues to raise the bar for its teachings of bushcraft and survival techniques. Find the latest news, guides and special offers from Ray Mears and Woodlore.

feeds.title: Forest Knights
feeds.description: Forest Knights are proud to be one of the leading Bushcraft Schools in the country and one of the longest established in West Sussex. We are proud to work with local schools and charities providing bushcraft, programs to meet their organization's goals using our expertise and experience to ensure that their client's learning is not only safe but enjoyable.

feeds.title: Bushcraft Education
feeds.description: This blog is to educate, and provide enriching experiences for young and old. Here we share ideas of how to use what has become known as 'bushcraft' in educational settings.

feeds.title: Forrester Bushcraft
feeds.description: A blog dedicated to learning, understanding and promoting Bushcraft and wilderness skills. Follow us through our journey into learning new skills and finding new places.

feeds.title: Paul Kirtley's Blog
feeds.description: Paul Kirtley's Blog provides articles, videos and podcasts to help improve your wilderness bushcraft, survival skills and outdoor life.
